name: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited
summary: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited manufactures and markets electric vehicle chargers and lithium-ion batteries in India and elsewhere, reporting in two segments called Critical Power and EV Charger. Products include energy storage, switched mode power systems, DC power conversion, solar chargers, telecom batteries and AC and DC chargers, with related software apps. Customers include charge point operators, fleets, hotels and hospitals.
